scope: Bounded VSAI conditional pairs and variable-length Proxy omission diagnostics; pure Go, no persistence.

priority_selection.reason: Batch102 prioritized explicit VSAI multiple-leaf evidence and Proxy variable omissions; this batch implements that selected slice.

assertions: VSAI both Auth/Acct maps5009 with both actual fields in original order; neither maps5005 with two four-byte zero examples. Missing VendorId retains precedence. Legacy errors.Is ErrField remains alongside the selected ErrDuplicate/ErrMissing sentinel.
Proxy missing Host uses a one-byte zero Identity minimum and zero padding; missing State uses a zero-length OctetString. Present empty binary State remains valid. Missing both selects Host first.
Generatorv19 bridges private versioned rule evidence through generated parents and external modules, preserving two repeated ancestor offsets without internal imports or retained request bytes.

The walker rechecks complete selected groups and ancestor key/flags/offset/path, conditions, framing, duplicate children and resource ceilings before allocating output. Quotes own bytes and include only selected leaves plus minimal ancestors.

TCP/TLS normal and emergency VSAI responses cover both field orders and neither; complete envelope, held charges, non-delivery, later valid work and close retirement are verified. Unsafe Proxy envelopes still close without fabricating a response.
Bare sentinels, unsupported rules, stale conditions, malformed framing and insufficient budgets do not produce inferred diagnostics. Profiles deliberately ignoring VSAI retain their opaque rule.
Public signatures/layouts, ops9, module manifests and protocol/profile inputs unchanged. Generatorv19 changes eleven digests and Bundle fingerprints. Original-build recovery restriction remains.
Twelve finite fuzz targets, dual-module static/pure/race/cross checks, finite pressure and separately sampled benchmarks. No new immutable release, persistence or real-target claim.
